scenarios.name: cmo_fever
scenarios.title: Crew medical officer: fever-like syndrome
scenarios.description: The crew medical officer drifts in heart rate, temperature, sleep and reaction time from day 15. The crew must run the protocol without its medical officer, with a Mars-like delay.

scenarios.name: sep_sleep_loss
scenarios.title: Solar particle event with sleep loss
scenarios.description: A solar radiation storm (NOAA S-scale) disrupts the cabin and the schedule from day 12: sleep drops and one crew member's HR and reaction time drift.

scenarios.name: co2_creep
scenarios.title: Slow cabin CO2 rise
scenarios.description: Cabin CO2 climbs from day 8 and several crew report headaches and slower reaction time. A shared exposure: check the habitat before treating anybody.
